description: Generate a structured, ECDSA-signed wallet trust fact profile. Send an EVM wallet address and get 45 base checks across 26 chains in 5 dimensions: stablecoins (USDC + USDT across 22 EVM chains), governance (UNI, AAVE, ARB, OP), NFTs (BAYC, Pudgy Penguins, Wrapped CryptoPunks), staking (stETH, rETH, cbETH), and institutional stablecoins (EURCV, USDCV, USDC, and BENJI across Ethereum, Solana, XRPL, Stellar, and Sui — the cross-chain entries evaluate when the matching optional wallet is supplied). Add optional Solana, XRPL, Bitcoin, and Tron wallets to reach up to 50 checks across 28 chains in 9 dimensions (adds Solana USDC, XRPL RLUSD + USDC, native BTC holdings, and Tron USDT-TRC20). Returns per-dimension pass/fail counts and an overall summary — no score, no opinion, just cryptographically verifiable evidence organized by dimension. Designed for AI agent-to-agent trust decisions. Costs 3 credits (standard) or 6 credits (proof: 'merkle').

bitcoinWallet.description: Bitcoin address. If provided, adds Bitcoin Holdings dimension (native BTC balance check).

proof.description: Set to 'merkle' for EIP-1186 Merkle storage proofs on stablecoin/governance checks (6 credits).

solanaWallet.description: Solana wallet address (base58). If provided, adds USDC on Solana and institutional EURCV/USDCV on Solana checks.

stellarWallet.description: Stellar wallet address (G-prefixed). If provided, adds institutional USDC and BENJI on Stellar checks (classic trustlines).

suiWallet.description: Sui wallet address (0x + 64 hex). If provided, adds institutional USDC on Sui check.

tronWallet.description: Tron wallet address (T-prefixed). If provided, adds USDT-TRC20 on Tron check.

xrplWallet.description: XRPL wallet address (r-address). If provided, adds RLUSD, USDC, and institutional EURCV on XRPL checks.

name: insumer_wallet_trust
